description: Executable golden regressions for PDF naming, PDF bookmarking follow-up, and OSC pleading/document reuse bugs. Every case is runnable by scripts/ops/document_golden_regression.py.

cases.title: 繳費單 OCR/命名：規費繳款單應產生閱卷/規費繳款命名並保留案號與當事人
cases.failure_shape: OCR 只抓到零散規費/繳費文字時，PDF namer 容易降級成泛用收據或文件，導致 OSC 待辦無法識別繳納期限。
expected_behavior: doc_type is 閱卷 or 法院通知/函文 with normalized deadline_type 繳納
filename contains court case number and party when present
filename does not use generic 文件/收據 when the text is a court fee payment notice

cases.title: 筆錄命名：訊問/準備程序/審判筆錄應歸類為筆錄並保留筆錄類型
cases.failure_shape: 筆錄 PDF 或下載後檔名被判為一般書狀/文件，後續 transcript indexer 無法穩定串接。
expected_behavior: filename body contains 訊問筆錄, 準備程序筆錄, 審判筆錄, 調查筆錄, or 勘驗筆錄
transcript repair helper remains idempotent for already-correct filenames

cases.title: 判決書或終局裁定及處分：裁判 PDF 應優先判為判決/裁定並符合裁判資料夾命名
cases.failure_shape: 位於判決書或終局裁定及處分資料夾的裁判 PDF 被信封頁、回執或泛用通知誤導，輸出非判決/裁定命名。
expected_behavior: path aliases for canonical and legacy judgment folders are accepted
doc_type remains 判決 or 裁定 when title/body has裁判 markers
filename includes court, case number, party if available, and 主文摘要 when extracted

cases.title: PDF 書籤：單一裁判文件無邊界時應寫入第 1 頁書籤而非永久 no-boundary
cases.failure_shape: pdf-bookmarker 對單一判決/裁定掃不到文件邊界時曾只記 no_boundary，後續不會產生任何 TOC。
expected_behavior: classification legitimate_single_doc is converted to a page-1 bookmark
no_boundary count is not incremented for confirmed single legal documents

cases.title: 書狀模板替換：沿用舊書狀索引只收我方歷次書狀內 Word，不受委任狀 Word 干擾
cases.failure_shape: 文件索引曾把 01_委任狀 內的 Word 檔列入沿用舊書狀候選，使用者可能誤拿委任狀當書狀底稿。
expected_behavior: only .doc/.docx under a path containing 我方歷次書狀 are indexed
Word temp files and PDF files are excluded
委任狀 folder Word files are excluded even when filename contains 書狀-like text
